about: Proposed region definitions for detailed maps of the Netherlands: its 12 provinces, one map region each, with a merged map of the whole country as an option. A proposal for discussion (docs/REGIONS-NL.md); no code reads this file, and it does not ship.
how_checked: Publishers' pages and public APIs read on 26 and 27 November 2026 by an AI assistant without an account, with a person reviewing the result. Figures marked measured come from a trial build of all twelve provinces (25 and 26 November 2026) and from calling this repository's code at main 51658f5.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:NL codes NL-DR, NL-FL, NL-FR, NL-GE, NL-GR, NL-LI, NL-NB, NL-NH, NL-OV, NL-UT, NL-ZE, NL-ZH.
codes.iso_checked: search only: secondary listings, not iso.org.
codes.why_the_prefix: Three of the twelve letter pairs are US state codes in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py): FL (Flevoland, Florida), NH (Noord-Holland, New Hampshire), UT (Utrecht, Utah). A bare NL is not.
codes.index_names: Address index ids must match [A-Z]{2} (engine/setup/manifest.py line 97), and engine/setup/install.py line 462 carries over only [A-Z]{2}.sqlite and .json. NL-FL does not fit and FL would be Florida. The trial named its indexes addresses/NL-<code>.sqlite and loaded the map set from outside the library, so the manifest was not involved.
codes.other_codes: CBS numbers the provinces PV20 to PV31 (StatLine; opened). The BAG writes its own province code in mixed case: ZH, NH, NB, but Gr, Fr, Dr, Ov, Fl, Ge, Ut, Ze, Li (opened, 25 November 2026).
codes.not_included: The Caribbean parts of the Kingdom: Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba (NL-BQ1 to NL-BQ3), and Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten (NL-AW, NL-CW, NL-SX). Their sources were not looked at.

totals.municipalities_cbs: 342 on 1 January 2026 (CBS, Gemeentelijke indeling op 1 januari 2026; search only)

box_notes: Every BAG address of a province lies inside its own box (measured over all 10,798,639).

The boxes overlap heavily: Gelderland's box holds 1,583,947 addresses of other provinces, more than its own 1,250,394, including 719,483 of Utrecht's 801,372; Flevoland's holds 342,791 against 238,815 of its own. A province cannot be cut from the BAG by its box. The trial asked the BAG by box and kept the records whose provincie_afkorting is the province's, compared without case.

OpenStreetMap came from Geofabrik's province extracts, cut by the province outline. The BAG holds no foreign addresses, so boxes that reach into Belgium and Germany (Aachen lies inside Limburg's) add no foreign rows from it; sources cut by box would.
A province's area includes its inland and coastal waters, so Flevoland's box takes in part of the IJsselmeer and Markermeer.

not_open_nationwide: Defibrillators: HartslagNu (the Dutch Heart Foundation) is the national register; data is given for research on request under a data access policy (search only), and the foundation has said it may not publish exact AED locations (NOS; search only). The Red Cross closed its open AED database on 28 February 2020 (HartslagNu; search only). A NOS article reports 25,840 registered AEDs (search only; date not checked). OSM has 4,370.

Sirens: the warning system (WAS) has about 4,278 sirens in towns of 1,000 people or more (a municipal factsheet; search only). The cabinet announced a new siren network on 9 June 2026 (rijksoverheid.nl; search only). OSM has 4,221 emergency=siren; whether they are the WAS sirens was not checked.
Pharmacies, fire stations and police stations: no open national list was looked for (not checked).

addressing.order: Street, house number with letter and addition, then postcode and place: 'Rotterdamseweg 374A, 2629 HG Delft'. Forms and parcels often ask for postcode and house number alone ('2629 HG 374'), which name one address.

postal_code.format: Four digits, never starting with 0, then two capital letters, written with a space; stored as 1234AB.
postal_code.relation_to_provinces: 15 four-digit areas and 14 full postcodes have addresses in two provinces; the largest real case is 7973 (335 in Drenthe, 24 in Overijssel) (measured).
postal_code.placeholders: 19 BAG rows carry placeholder postcodes: 9999ZZ (Zwolle, Rotterdam), 9999AA (Someren), 9999XX (Roermond), 1234AB (Finsterwolde), 1234XX (Lemiers). 9999 itself is real, in Stitswerd (measured).

house_number.without_postcode_what: outbuildings with an addition such as ts, berths and caravan pitches

addressing.places: The place is the BAG woonplaats, often not the municipality (Ter Apel, in Westerwolde). 2,503 places have 2,428 names. The Hague is 's-Gravenhage in the BAG and Den Haag in speech; 's-Hertogenbosch is Den Bosch.
addressing.counts_source: the trial build's twelve address indexes, 27 November 2026 (measured)

current_code.read: engine/address_search.py at main 51658f5, 27 November 2026, by calling its functions
current_code.german_order: 'Rotterdamseweg 374A, 2629 HG Delft' and 'Spui 70, 2511 BT Den Haag' are read by _parts_de with the postcode's digits (2629, 2511) as the house number and 374a in the street.
current_code.number_first: '2629 HG 374' is a US address for is_address_query: house 2629 on a street called 'hg 374'.
current_code.normalize: normalize() and normalize_de() keep only a-z and 0-9: 'Ruïnelaan' becomes 'ru nelaan', 'Fryslân' 'frysl n'.
current_code.indexes: find_addresses reads only indexes whose meta norm is us or de-1.

addressing.trial_rule: norm = nl-1 in the index's meta and norm column: lower case, accents off, punctuation to spaces, a word ending in 'straat' shortened to 'str'. Postcode with or without its space, letter and addition, the postcode-first form, other names for places, no US-state guess.
